guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, state_q is synchronously cleared to all zeros ('{default: '0}).
When rst_ni is high and state_we equals SP2V_HIGH, state_q is updated with the value of state_d.
When rst_ni is high and state_we is not equal to SP2V_HIGH, state_q retains its previous value (implicit hold).

assumptions.claim: state_d must be stable and valid at the positive clock edge when state_we equals SP2V_HIGH.
assumptions.risk: Stale or invalid data is captured into the secret-state register state_q.

assumptions.claim: SP2V_HIGH must be defined as the active-high logic level that matches the write-enable signaling of state_we.
assumptions.risk: If SP2V_HIGH is incorrectly defined, write-enable may never be true or may always be true, breaking the update mechanism.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be asserted (low) whenever the secret material in state_q needs to be cleared for security reasons.
assumptions.risk: If rst_ni is not used properly, residual secret data may persist in state_q across operational phases.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be synchronously de-asserted with respect to clk_i to avoid metastability or partial-state corruption.
assumptions.risk: Asynchronous or poorly timed reset release could leave state_q in an unknown or partially-cleared state.

uncertain_points.claim: The timing relationship between state_we and state_d is not locally controlled; a mismatch may cause state_q to capture transitional or invalid data.
uncertain_points.risk: Corruption of secret state matrix, leading to incorrect cipher output or key leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: state_q is only cleared by reset; there is no explicit data-independent clearing (wipe) at operation end or on error, which may leave secret data in the register.
uncertain_points.risk: Secret residual data exposure if a subsequent process can read state_q or if the design does not overwrite it before reuse.

uncertain_points.claim: The write-enable constant SP2V_HIGH is not defined in this block; incorrect parameter override could break the enable logic.
uncertain_points.risk: Functional failure (stuck state or perpetual write) leading to AES state corruption.
